summary: Large installations finish their nightly work much sooner, and the logs say what really happened.

fixes.title: Configuration items finish much faster
fixes.text: On large installations the last part of building the configuration items took many hours. Each part now reads only its own records, so it ends much sooner.

fixes.title: Logs mention AI only when AI is used
fixes.text: The privilege tier log now says which catalog version gave the tiers and no longer suggests an AI request that was not made.

fixes.title: Risk Analysis warnings name the real failure
fixes.text: A warning that every way of reading the data failed now names the one that really failed last, with its error. A count used only for timing no longer raises a warning.
